components.css: .ds-experience{font-family:var(--font-sans,'Manrope Variable',sans-serif);color:#000;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dedede);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dedede)}.ds-experience summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2.4fr auto;gap:25px;padding:27px 0;align-items:center;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-experience summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-date{font-size:12px;color:var(--color-secondary,#626262)}.ds-role{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}.ds-role strong{font-size:20px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-role>span{font-size:13px;color:var(--color-secondary,#626262)}.ds-experience[open] .ds-plus{display:none}.ds-experience p{margin:0 0 0 29%;padding:0 35px 28px 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--color-secondary,#626262);max-width:70ch}.ds-experience summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-experience summary{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;padding:23px 0}.ds-date{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:11px}.ds-role strong{font-size:18px}.ds-role>span{font-size:12px}.ds-experience p{margin-left:0;padding-right:0;font-size:13px}}

narrative.overview:
A modern monochrome portfolio built around generous open space and Manrope typography. Oversized lettering supplies personality; neutral grays support reading, and the black section reverses the same palette.

The implemented system is mostly flat, with thin dividers and restrained rounded controls. A soft shadow and tilted browser frame give the real project screenshot depth. Motion is concentrated in the interactive name and directional cues.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black and white with supporting neutral grays.
Manrope throughout, with medium headings and extra-bold identity lettering.
Open grids, thin dividers, and selective rounded shapes.
Focused interaction with keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Use black, white, and supporting neutral grays throughout the interface.

rules.name: The Selective Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve the soft shadow for the project browser preview; use whitespace and dividers elsewhere.

dos: Do use Manrope and the implemented monochrome roles.
Do preserve open spacing, responsive stacking, and readable text widths.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, semantic disclosures, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use authentic project imagery with the existing grayscale treatment.
donts: Don't introduce chromatic accents or ornamental badges into this confirmed world.
Don't apply the project preview shadow to every section or content row.
Don't invent portraits, project imagery, or unsupported content.
